name: Wyoming
source: Wyoming levies no personal income tax, estate tax or inheritance tax. Primary sources read on 2026-10-24: Wyoming Legislature LSO, Wyoming Tax Rates and Collections, June 3, 2025 (https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-202506032-01WyomingtaxstructureratesandcollectionsJune32025.pdf: individual income tax 0%, FY24 collections $0); W.S. title 39 (https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf: chapter 12 holds only W.S. 39-12-101, which bars local income taxes; W.S. 39-19-103 sets the estate tax equal to the federal state death tax credit); 26 U.S.C. 2011(f) (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2012-title26/html/USCODE-2012-title26-subtitleB-chap11-subchapA-partII-sec2011.htm: no credit for decedents dying after 2004); Wyoming Constitution art. 15 sec. 18 (https://sos.wyo.gov/Forms/Publications/WYConstitution.pdf); Department of Revenue (https://revenue.wyo.gov/: excise, mineral and property taxes only). Second sources: MOAA state report card (https://www.moaa.org/content/state-report-card/wyoming/) and Tax Foundation, State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/state-income-tax-rates-2026/)

filing_tables.note: Every filing status uses the one zero-rate table: Wyoming has no individual income tax (LSO tax rates table: 0%, FY24 collections $0; W.S. title 39 chapter 12 levies no income tax), read 2026-10-24.

state_base.note: Wyoming has no state income tax, so it has no income base and adds nothing back: W.S. title 39 chapter 12 holds only W.S. 39-12-101 (local preemption) and levies no tax; LSO tax rates table shows individual income tax 0% (https://wyoleg.gov/InterimCommittee/2025/03-202506032-01WyomingtaxstructureratesandcollectionsJune32025.pdf), read 2026-10-24.

income_brackets.note: No personal income tax: the LSO Wyoming Tax Rates and Collections table shows individual income tax 0% with no collections, and W.S. title 39 levies none (read 2026-10-24).

estate_inheritance.note: Wyoming levies no estate tax and no inheritance tax: W.S. 39-19-103 and 39-19-104 (title 39 chapter 19) set the only death tax equal to the federal state death tax credit, and 26 U.S.C. 2011(f) allows no credit for decedents dying after December 31, 2004 (https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCODE-2012-title26/html/USCODE-2012-title26-subtitleB-chap11-subchapA-partII-sec2011.htm), so the tax is zero; chapter 19 imposes no tax on heirs. Read 2026-10-24.

social_security.note: Wyoming has no personal income tax (LSO tax rates table: individual income tax 0%, FY24 collections $0; W.S. title 39 chapter 12 levies none), so Social Security benefits are not taxed. Read 2026-10-24.

local_income_tax.note: Wyoming counties and cities levy no income tax: W.S. 39-12-101 reserves income, earnings and wage taxes to the state and bars any county, city, town or other political subdivision from levying them (https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title39.pdf, read 2026-10-24; also validation run 3, 2026-10-22).

sales_tax.check_at: Wyoming revenue department sales and use tax rate tables
sales_tax.source: Tax Foundation, State and Local Sales Tax Rates, Midyear 2026 (https://taxfoundation.org/data/all/state/2026-sales-tax-rates-midyear/), as of 2026-07-01; groceries and clothing: https://zamp.com/resources/sales-tax-on-groceries and https://zamp.com/blog/sales-tax-on-clothing
sales_tax.note: Rates as fractions; avg_local_rate is the combined less the state rate, at least 0. vehicle_rate is the purchase tax on a car: assumed equal to the combined rate. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py. Groceries and clothing: grocery_rate is the state rate on groceries (0.0) plus the average local rate where locals tax them (locals: no); research note: Food for domestic home consumption exempt from state and local. clothing_taxable is true (research: yes; taxed). Set by hand from .claude/state/research/grocery-tax.csv and clothing-tax.csv (s329).

property_tax.check_at: Census ACS 2024 1-year tables B25090 and B25082 at https://data.census.gov
property_tax.source: Census ACS 2024 1-year (B25090 / B25082) as compiled at https://floridaprobateandfamilylaw.com/blog/effective-property-tax-rates-by-state-2025/
property_tax.note: Effective rate: real-estate taxes paid divided by home value, owner-occupied homes. Senior relief, homestead caps and freezes are not in it (a buyer pays the full rate). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

home_insurance.source: Insurify state table for a 300,000 dwelling (https://insurify.com/homeowners-insurance/states/), October 2026
home_insurance.note: Average annual premium for a 300,000 dwelling. Quote averages differ by 20 to 40 percent between publishers, so the model uses it as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_insurance.source: Insurify full coverage, monthly times 12 (https://insurify.com/car-insurance/states/), October 2026
car_insurance.note: Average annual full-coverage premium. Used as a ratio between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

car_taxes.source: Wyoming Legislature copy of W.S. 31-3-101, Teton County fee page and county10.com, 2026
car_taxes.note: Wyoming: a county fee (a vehicle property tax) of 3% of the factory price times 60% in year one, then 50, 40, 30, 20 and 15% from year six, plus a 30 state fee. For a 40,000 car kept ten years the county fee averages 330 a year; about 360 with the state fee. Typical car, averaged over about ten years of ownership; registration and vehicle taxes only (no title, plate or inspection fees). Set by hand after the import: rerunning importStateCosts.py resets it to 0. Confirmed primary on W.S. 31-3-101 (https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title31.pdf, validation run 3, 2026-10-22).

fuel.source: Excise: https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/policyinformation/statistics/2024/mf205.cfm (validation run 2, 2026-10-22); price: USGasGauge state-by-year table (AAA data), 2024 annual average
fuel.note: gas_tax_per_gallon is the state excise in dollars, without sales tax on fuel: 0.24 (24 cents (since 2013)); average_price_per_gallon is the 2024 average pump price (grade unclear, about regular). Set by hand from the primary source in validation run 2, 2026-10-22; importStateCosts.py keeps a hand-set section.

utilities.source: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, residential price, January to July 2026
utilities.note: Average residential electricity price in dollars per kWh, January to July 2026 (a partial year). Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

housing.check_at: https://fred.stlouisfed.org (Zillow Home Value Index by state) and https://meric.mo.gov/data/cost-living-data-series
housing.source: Zillow Home Value Index by state via FRED (September 2026); MERIC Cost of Living Data Series housing index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026
housing.note: typical_home_value is the Zillow Home Value Index (all homes, middle tier); cost_index is the MERIC housing cost index (US = 100), used to scale rent after a move. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

health_premiums.check_at: https://www.kff.org/affordable-care-act/state-indicator/average-marketplace-premiums-by-metal-tier/, Wyoming insurance department Medigap rate guide and the CMS MA Landscape and Part D files (https://www.cms.gov)
health_premiums.source: KFF Average Marketplace Premiums by Metal Tier 2026 (benchmark silver at 40, times the federal age curve 2.124 for 60); MoneyGeek Medicare Supplement Plan G at 65, 2026; KFF Average Monthly Premium for PDPs, 2024; MedicareSupplement.com analysis of the CMS 2026 MA Landscape files
health_premiums.note: Monthly premiums per person, unsubsidized list prices: aca_60_monthly is the benchmark silver plan at 60 (estimated from the age-40 figure), medigap_g_monthly Plan G at 65, part_d_monthly the enrollment-weighted Part D plan, medicare_advantage_monthly the average Medicare Advantage premium. Null means no usable figure; a move then leaves that premium unchanged. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

price_indexes.source: MERIC Cost of Living Data Series grocery index (C2ER, US = 100), Q2 2026; BEA Regional Price Parities by state, goods and other services (US = 100), 2024, release of 2026-02-19 via FRED
price_indexes.note: Price levels with US = 100: grocery_index is the MERIC grocery index, bea_goods and bea_services the BEA Regional Price Parities for goods and for services other than rent. Used as ratios between states only. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.

long_term_care.source: Genworth / CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Ranked State Data Tables, state medians (https://assets.carescout.com/a41bb6478c/298701.pdf)
long_term_care.note: State median monthly costs: a home health aide, an assisted living facility and a private nursing home room. Stored for reference; the model does not use them. Imported from .claude/state/research/state-costs.csv and state-costs-2.csv by .claude/state/scratch/importStateCosts.py.
